text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning, I saw El Condor Pasa 
practicing dance lessons all by herself.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! What do you think, isn't it a 
dynamic dance?

Her movements were certainly dynamic, but 
in a live concert, there was a risk she 
might overlap with the other Umamusume's 
choreography.
choice_data_list:
Try focusing on dancing together with 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It is difficult. When I dance 
alone, I inadvertently stop paying 
attention to my surroundings...
choice_data_list:
Let's dance somewhere around here that 
catches your eye.
Let's dance while looking in the mirror.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Que!? A place that caught your eye... 
Where are we going, yes?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... If we're gonna dance 
here, we definitely gotta be mindful of 
our surroundings, yes...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, trying not to bump into people 
takes more stamina than I thought, desu...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Howevvver! That is precisely what makes it 
worth taking on!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Tackling tough challenges is what El is 
all about, after all! I promise you, I 
will master it, yeeees!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you my improved dancing next 
time! Please look forward to it!

A few days later, she showed me her dance 
moves, and just as she had declared, she 
had gotten leaps and bounds better.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You are saying I should dance while 
watching myself, yes?
choice_data_list:
Let's dance while being mindful of where 
we're looking

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see! As expected of Trainer-san! With 
that, I should be able to do it on my own 
desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...That said, staring into your own eyes 
while dancing... is so intense, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I will not lose to myself! El will do her 
absolute beeeest!

Afterward, El Condor Pasa practiced while 
watching herself in the mirror, mastering 
movements that wouldn't get in anyone 
else's way.
